slide_1.title_shape: Enterprise AI Program Coordination Under Operational Constraints
slide_1.first_textbox: Several business units launched AI-enabled forecasting, support automation, and quality detection in parallel. The delivery sequence required formal dependency tracking, jurisdiction-specific compliance checks, and cross-team release governance before production rollout.
slide_1.second_textbox: Leadership merged performance and risk indicators into one operating rhythm, including queue pressure, model drift, incident recovery duration, staffing utilization, and remediation backlog burn-down across departments.
slide_1.third_textbox: Inconsistent escalation standards delayed incident resolution on peak days
slide_1.fourth_textbox: Cross-team handoff quality dropped when ownership models diverged
slide_1.fifth_textbox: Executive reviews demanded weekly measurable remediation progress
